vetSays.line: 🛡️ Karl, Viola and Marikit met them at the door — 3 put down. Karl, Viola, Marikit are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Viola, Obiero, Jorge and Adaeze met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Viola, Obiero, Jorge are hurt.
🛡️ Viola, Adaeze, Theo and Carlos met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Viola, Adaeze, Theo, Carlos are hurt.
